explanation: London introduced 999 in June 1937, making it the oldest emergency telephone number. The first 911 call was made in Haleyville, Alabama, in February 1968.

claims.text: The 999 emergency telephone number came into use in London on 30 June 1937.
The first 911 call in the United States was made in Haleyville, Alabama, on 16 February 1968.
999 is the oldest emergency telephone number in the world.
